description.from:
Implements LIM-ee79f5. Begin with its Gherkin scenarios.

Scope:
- Add a document-level suggestion mode alongside existing targeted rewrite options.
- Pass the full draft, portable profile, diagnosis/annotations, and reference samples to the suggestion resolver.
- Produce one or more non-destructive candidates with rationale, unresolved questions, factual-verification warnings, and a reviewable diff.
- Accept finding decisions as optional guidance only.
- Reuse existing explicit apply and verifier primitives; do not alter the original draft.

Definition of done:
- A holistic candidate can address multiple findings coherently.
- Targeted options retain their current behavior.
- Every candidate is review-only until an explicit apply.
- Tests cover holistic and targeted paths, source preservation, and forbidden detector-evasion tactics.

Out of scope: mandatory decision records, unattended rewrite/apply, publication, and telemetry.
description.to:
Implements LIM-ee79f5. Begin with its revised Gherkin scenarios.

Scope:
- Every rewrite-suggestion request returns one or more cohesive, document-level candidates; do not introduce a mode switch.
- Pass the full draft, portable profile, diagnosis/annotations, and reference samples to the resolver.
- Selected findings and decisions are optional focusing guidance only; they must not force a patch-only response.
- Produce review-only candidates with rationale, unresolved questions, factual-verification warnings, and a reviewable diff.
- Reuse existing explicit apply and verifier primitives; do not alter the original draft.

Definition of done:
- A candidate can address multiple findings coherently, even when guidance names only one.
- Existing finding data remains accessible for callers that want it.
- Every candidate is review-only until an explicit apply.
- Tests cover standard and guidance-focused requests, source preservation, and forbidden detector-evasion tactics.

Out of scope: mode flags, mandatory decision records, unattended rewrite/apply, publication, and telemetry.
